canonical_object.definition: A fixed oblique rank-three lattice with direct geometry, reciprocal geometry, an independent positive-definite address-energy form, a centered 27-state ternary registry, a seven-sheet A2-parallel polarity complex, complete factor-three aggregation, cubical closure, and a locked projective Mass Bridge.

seven_sheet_complex.closure_registry: A2*/A2 is Z3; combined with polarity Z2 gives Z6

local_incidence.cell3_adjacency: J tensor I tensor I + I tensor J tensor I + I tensor I tensor J

hierarchy.aggregation_rule: n = 3^g complete Cell3 volumes per axis

cubical_topology.interpretation: The complete finite Lucas Supergroup is contractible. Center-graph cycles become coexact after plaquettes are included.

reciprocal_spectrum.k_form_formula: Lambda_j = xi_j^T R xi_j; multiplicity m_k(j)=binomial(r(j),k)

observer_rendering.general_force_formula: F_K = M_active kappa_F H [omega cross (G_phase V_ref)]
observer_rendering.thin_rim_formula: F_rim = (kappa_F M omega / 2) n_hat cross (G_phase V_ref)
observer_rendering.circular_oscillator_formula: Fbar_K = M_active pi kappa_F f C_pol H [n_hat cross (G_phase V_ref)]

energy_bands.modular_rule: B_m mod 6 is 0 when 3 divides m, otherwise 2

internal_hamiltonian.assembly: H = H_rest + H_W + H_Emily + H_A2 + H_sheet + H_Bloch + H_CMB + H_Coulomb + H_carry

terms.H_W: kappa_W sum_L 0.5 L^T W L n_L
terms.H_Coulomb: alpha hbar c sum_i<j P_i P_j / r_ij

minimal_axioms.name: Fixed frame and basis
minimal_axioms.statement: One fixed ICRS/J2000 origin and one ordered invertible left-handed basis B; observer motion does not redefine B.

minimal_axioms.name: Lossless integer addressing
minimal_axioms.statement: The global field is B Z^3; M and R generate direct and reciprocal geometry.

minimal_axioms.name: Centered half-step Cell3 registry
minimal_axioms.statement: One Cell3 is sampled by {-1,0,1}^3 through p=B L/2.

minimal_axioms.name: Laminar grade and polarity
minimal_axioms.statement: lambda=i+j+k and chi=(-1)^lambda define the A2-parallel sheet complex.

minimal_axioms.name: Local incidence
minimal_axioms.statement: Nearest-neighbor motion changes one address coordinate by one, producing P3^3 and the Emily spectrum.

minimal_axioms.name: Complete-cell recursion by three
minimal_axioms.statement: Only complete Cell3 volumes aggregate; n=3^g defines the hierarchy.

minimal_axioms.name: Independent positive address-energy form
minimal_axioms.statement: W is positive definite and G_phase=4B^-T W B^-1.

minimal_axioms.name: Locked bridge and observer rendering
minimal_axioms.statement: Mass-Bridge ratios are fixed; physical force additionally requires an observer packet, shape tensor, and kappa_F.

canonical_corrections: 27 Lucas nodes interpreted as 27 Cell3 volumes
One Cell3 has 27 half-step states; a Lucas Group has 27 complete Cell3 volumes.
6,859 states interpreted as corner nodes
A Supergroup has 1,000 unrefined corner nodes and 6,859 half-step states.
A and B used interchangeably for direct basis
Terminal convention is B=[a b c]; inverse or inverse transpose is reciprocal.
M, R, W, G_phase, and Q treated as aliases
They are distinct typed tensors with different units and roles.
CMB vector identified with a Cell3 normal
CMB is external traversal direction; Cell3 and laminar normals derive from B.
Seven Emily zero modes treated as Laplacian/Hodge modes
Adjacency nullity is 7; connected Laplacian nullity is 1; global Hodge scalar nullity is 1.
1,216 center cycles treated as nontrivial topology
They are coexact after plaquettes are included; beta1=0.
55 sheet modes treated as physical zero modes
Orientation lifts 54; one constant scalar mode remains.
Registry standing wave identified with PDE cavity mode
Registry cosine, Bloch, and hard-wall Helmholtz modes are distinct.
Native geometry identified with nanometre witness
Native geometry is primary; nanometre rendering is a scale witness.
Mass-Bridge values refitted to later constants
Projective ratios are locked; physical constants are downstream witnesses.
E_m=B_m epsilon_3 used with a per-Cell3 quantum
Use E_m=729 B_m epsilon_3 = B_m epsilon_LS.
Proton carrier treated as primitive
Current Earth-CMB branch is electron-carrier normalized.
Galaxy positions used as occupancy domain
The domain is projective galaxy-axis orientation on the unit sphere.
Early force reduction retained
Edition 1784915217 is superseded by corrected edition 1784985105.
Original 13-element result retained as controlling
It is superseded by strict linear-inertia composition.
